source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: MainActivity displays a navigation that relies on FeatureRegistry to present the settings of each system app. On the Xposed side, HookEntry enables hooks per package, for example systemui and android, which find classes thanks to the DexKit cache.
